SELECT company.code FROM companies company WHERE company.id = #{companyId} AND company.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT department.id AS id, department.code AS code, department.name AS name, department.is_deleted AS is_deleted, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users user_account WHERE user_account.department_id = department.id AND user_account.is_deleted = FALSE ) AS active_user_count, department.created_at AS created_at, department.updated_at AS updated_at FROM departments department WHERE department.id = #{departmentId} AND department.company_id = #{companyId} AND department.is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO departments ( company_id, code, name, is_deleted, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{code}, #{name}, FALSE, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
